subject.title: Feature/Fix: Validate and optimize lineage token accounting

question: Should CodexBar sponsor the four-PR lineage architecture as its future token-accounting path, while merging it initially in shadow-only form and deferring authority promotion?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent and strongly tested, but choosing a 6,201-line accounting architecture over continued narrow fixes determines long-term cache, performance, and correctness contracts; tests cannot make that product and maintenance commitment.

options.title: Sponsor shadow-only stack
options.body: Review and merge https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2155 through https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2158 in order, retain legacy authority, and require additional upgrade and finalized-day evidence before promotion.

options.title: Prefer narrow accounting fixes
options.body: Continue with the current phase-one containment and reconcile or land the focused identity/cache work in https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2118 without adopting the lineage architecture yet.

options.title: Pause the rearchitecture
options.body: Leave or close the stack until additional real-world accuracy evidence makes the long-term maintenance cost clearly worthwhile.

recommendation.title: Sponsor shadow-only stack
recommendation.body: Review and merge https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2155 through https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2158 in order, retain legacy authority, and require additional upgrade and finalized-day evidence before promotion.

likelyOwner.reason: As repository owner and merger of the current accounting baseline, steipete is the strongest available owner for the architecture and rollout decision.
